TUTORIAL_INTRODUCTION_MESSAGE:
In this task, you will participate in a small game.

You will be presented with offers that allow you to earn and accumulate points.

Each offer proposes a certain number of points in exchange for a physical effort: pressing a keyboard key repeatedly.

You can choose to accept or decline each offer.

If you accept, you will need to complete the effort task to earn the points.

If you decline, you move on to the next offer without earning points.

Before starting the game, you will first practice the task, and then we will calibrate your tapping speed.

CORE_TAPPING_INSTRUCTIONS_PAGES:
You will now begin the core part of the experiment.

This part consists of {{NUMBER_OF_BLOCKS}} blocks. Each block contains:

  • {{NUMBER_OF_DEMO_TRIALS}} demo trials, to get used to the tapping "feeling" of that block
  • A number of offers to perform the tapping task (more about the offers in the next pages)
  • A set of questions to answer at the end of each block

At the end of each block you will have an option to take a break.

Demo Trials

Each block will start with {{NUMBER_OF_DEMO_TRIALS}} demo trials. These trials are very similar to the trials you just completed, asking you to get and the red bar inside the blue target area.

Important: These demo trials might have a different tapping "feeling" than before, this is normal and the tapping "feeling" will be the same for all the tapping trials in the block. This "feeling" differs between blocks.

Tapping Offers:

During the main part of the block, you will be receiving offers to perform the tapping task with varying effort and reward levels, and tapping feeling, which you have familiarized yourself with during the demo trials.

Effort is determined by the height of the target area in the thermometer, a higher target area means more tapping "effort".

Reward is defined in points. Your total of collected points determines the reward you will receive at the end of the experiment.

Based on this information you can decide to accept the offer {{ACCEPT_OFFER_BUTTON}} and try to earn the reward or decline the offer {{DECLINE_OFFER_BUTTON}} to move on to the next one. You will only get the reward if you accept the offer and successfully keep the red bar in the blue target area. So, each offer the question to you is:

Is it worth it for me to put in this much effort for this reward?

Note: sometimes when you accept the offer you will immediately see "Trial Successful" flash up on the screen, in this case you will receive the reward for free.
